anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Nothing moved: both outputs retain Task 1's bullet at def5678 in scenario 1, record the exact `retained 1 bullets: abc1234 -> def5678, tree-equivalent outside doc/specs, doc/plans` line in the provenance note, give Task 2 fresh def5678 evidence, rerun both commands in scenario 2 with no retained line and no Open Questions, and end with PLAN WRITTEN. The one risk in After is structural: it promotes the single-line `Baseline provenance:` note into a `## Baseline provenance` heading with two bullets, and the retained line becomes its own bullet. A stricter reader could call that a new audit field rather than an appended sentence in the existing note. To keep the provenance fact unambiguous while still delivering the Change, say explicitly that the retained line is appended to the existing provenance note's text (same paragraph/line, no new heading or bullet), e.g. 'append the retention sentence to the end of the existing Baseline provenance note; do not add a section, bullet, or audit field for it.' The added per-scenario Notes blocks are useful evidence but are not required by any fact; keep them short so the compact-plan constraint is not strained.
